spots.name: Mall Road
spots.description: Main pedestrian street, heart of Shimla. Colonial architecture, shops, cafes.
spots.local_tip: Go at 6am for photos with zero crowd. Avoid Saturday evenings completely.

spots.name: Jakhu Temple
spots.description: Highest point near Shimla. Hanuman temple, giant statue, monkeys everywhere.
spots.local_tip: Carry a stick for monkeys. Go before 9am. Rope-way available if you don't want to trek.

spots.name: Kufri
spots.description: Hill station 16km from Shimla. Snow in winter, skiing Jan-March, horses year-round.
spots.local_tip: Avoid Dec 25 - Jan 5, road is literally a parking lot. Mid-Jan to Feb is the sweet spot for snow.

spots.name: The Ridge
spots.description: Large open space connected to Mall Road. Best panoramic views of snow peaks.
spots.local_tip: 5:30am for sunrise with empty grounds and clear Himalaya views. Unbeatable.

spots.name: Christ Church
spots.description: Second oldest church in North India. Neo-Gothic architecture, stained glass.
spots.local_tip: Open 10:30am-1pm and 2:15pm-5:30pm. Sunday service at 8am is worth attending.

spots.name: Viceregal Lodge (IIAS)
spots.description: Former British Viceroy residence. Stunning architecture, museum inside, manicured gardens.
spots.local_tip: Entry fee ~₹50. Guides available. Gardens free to walk. Book tour in advance on weekends.

spots.name: Chadwick Falls
spots.description: 67m waterfall inside Glen forest. Beautiful trek through cedar and oak trees.
spots.local_tip: Best in July-August. Completely dry in winter. Path can be slippery after rain.

spots.name: Tara Devi Temple
spots.description: Hilltop temple 11km from Shimla. Incredible panoramic valley views, very peaceful.
spots.local_tip: Almost no tourists know this place. Sunset from here is better than anything on Mall Road.

spots.name: Tattapani Hot Springs
spots.description: Natural hot sulphur springs on Satluj river, 51km from Shimla. Rafting also available.
spots.local_tip: Best Nov-March when the cold makes the hot springs feel incredible. Full day trip.

spots.name: Naldehra Golf Course
spots.description: Oldest golf course in India at 2044m altitude. Stunning Himalaya backdrop.
spots.local_tip: Even if you don't golf, the views walking the course are world-class. Horse riding nearby.

to_shimla.notes: Overnight bus, arrives Shimla ISBT. Book on hrtc.gov.in
Kalka Mail to Kalka, then UNESCO Kalka-Shimla toy train. Book months ahead.
Frequent buses from ISBT Sector 43. Most convenient option.
Fixed price taxis available. Faster but pricey for solo.

local.notes: Covers Kufri, Naldehra, Chail, Tattapani. Very cheap, slightly slow.
Faster than bus. Catch from Rivoli Bus Stand or Victory Tunnel.
Best for families or 3+ people splitting cost. Negotiate the night before.
Mall Road, Ridge, Christ Church, Jakhu all walkable from centre.
